[[Xalnax's Destiny]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Zalnax]], a [[boss]] in the [[Vloxen Excavations]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1 
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Caged Shortbow]] [[dye]]d black.
